reason: I use free apps until they stop working, and the free one already does everything I need. Pet skins and widgets are nice but I'm not paying for them.
objection: I'll probably stop using the app in two weeks like every other one, so $7 would be wasted.
would_change_my_mind: If I'd still been using it every day for a couple of months and one cute pet or the widget really helped me start tasks, maybe at a lower price.
